ctx.x: Yeah, that was '40. That was '40, and probably '41, too, because the band got together in the summer, and I know we were in the Northwest about in October, because everyone had to sign up for the draft, you know, in October, and I think where I signed up was in Portland, Oregon, because we were on the road; that's why I remember that.
And so I stayed with them until early '41, but when he got ready to go to the Grand Terrace was when I left, and Shadow Wilson replaced me.
How did you like working with Hamp's band?
